note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Only three candidates were nominated for the fourteen divisions of the district; all the other outgoing members were automatically returned and there were no contests. Polling in County Down took place on 25 May 1933. Filed on 1933-05-25, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
